hypotheses.R0_all_split_bases_are_discovery_only: Every split fits exactly 192 of 256 discovery sites and evaluates its complementary 64 sites without overlap.
hypotheses.R1_score_fidelity_is_split_stable: Across split choices, the external-corpus range of prediction and target fidelity is at most 0.05 in every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_margin_fidelity_is_split_stable: Across split choices, the external-corpus range of margin fidelity is at most 0.10 in every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_every_split_recovers_scores: Every split's rank-64 role quotient retains at least 0.80 prediction and target fidelity on every external corpus.
hypotheses.R4_correct_roles_beat_swapped_roles: For every split and external corpus, correct assignment exceeds swapped assignment by at least 0.10 in mean endpoint fidelity.
hypotheses.R5_role_bases_are_subspace_stable: Relative to the head split, every context, tangent, and output rank-64 basis has normalized projector overlap at least 0.75.
hypotheses.R6_margin_is_systematically_harder: In every split and external corpus, margin fidelity is at least 0.15 below the mean of prediction and target fidelity.
hypotheses.R7_heldout_split_predicts_external_behav: Across split choices, mean validation fidelity and mean held-out FineWeb fidelity have positive Spearman correlation.
